question: If the selling price of five Bluetooth devices is ₹14,430 after allowing a discount of 26% on the marked price, then the marked price of one device is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Selling price of 1 device = 14430 ÷ 5 = ₹2,886

Value of SP is (100% − 26%) = 74% of the Marked Price.

MP = 2886 × (100 ÷ 74) = ₹3,900

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling price of 5 devices = ₹14,430

Discount allowed = 26%

 
 Marked Price
 100% (MP)

 

 

 −26% Discount

 
 Selling Price
 74% = ₹2886
 
 100% = ₹2886 × (100 ÷ 74) = ₹3900

**Formula Used:**

SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Selling price of 1 device = 14430 ÷ 5 = ₹2,886

⇒ 2886 = MP × (100 − 26) ÷ 100

⇒ 2886 = MP × (74 ÷ 100)

⇒ MP = (2886 × 100) ÷ 74

⇒ MP = 39 × 100 = ₹3,900

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price (MP) and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP) of an article. Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount amount.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given, the single equivalent discount percentage is given by: (a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100)%.

Relationship between CP and MP

The direct ratio of Cost Price to Marked Price can be determined by the formula: CP ÷ MP = (100 − Discount%) ÷ (100 + Profit%).
